integrity.computer_checks: supplemental exact-rational tests; not a substitute for proof
integrity.proof: complete analytic argument supplied for all real slopes and positive integer periods

limitations: Does not treat a single primitive orbit or primitive-only periodic-point statistics.
No extension to asymmetric branch slopes, nonuniform probabilities, or higher Wasserstein powers.
Closely related 2022 skew-tent paper available only as a publisher preview; unindexed equivalent results cannot be excluded.
scientific_scope: Symmetric generalized tent maps with every real slope at least two; uniform measures on all fixed points of the nth iterate, compared with the equal-weight Bernoulli measure of the compact repeller; Euclidean first Wasserstein and Kolmogorov distances.
title: Exact transport error of complete periodic-point censuses in generalized tent repellers
